messages:
mia_support: Hey team — vendor ACME Inc.'s autopay invoice #98765 is failing repeatedly. Customer reports 4 attempts today, all card declines. Logs show mixed `insufficient_funds` and `fraud_suspected`, plus one `3DS` challenge that failed. Need help triaging.

mia_support: Repro steps: merchant charges via autopay config, amount 12,450. Sample request/response (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/charges 
{ "merchant_id": "m_acme_01", "method": "card", "card_last4": "4242", "amount": 12450, "autopay": true }

RESP 402 {
  "status": "failed",
  "decline_code": "insufficient_funds",
  "issuer_code": "51",
  "gateway_txn": "gw_8f7a23",
  "notes": "fraud_suspected on attempt 2, 3ds_result: challenge_failed, acs_status: cookie_block"
}
```

payments-bot: Created ticket <https://redwood.tickets/PAY-3125|PAY-3125> and tagged @ash_payment. :white_check_mark:

ash_payment: Looking. Can you paste the gateway trace id and the full `gw_` id? Also need acquirer id and BIN range if available. Any merchant PO/VAT requirements on this account?

mia_support: Gateway trace: `gw_8f7a23` (attached in ticket). Acquirer: acq_northwave_3. BIN: 424242. Merchant settings excerpt: `require_po: true`, `vat_id: ""` (merchant hasn't supplied VAT id).

nora_am: FYI the merchant recently toggled `require_po` on for enterprise invoices — they expect PO numbers before settlement. That has caused a handful of holds historically. Not sure it would cause declines but flagging.

ash_payment: Two parallel failures likely: 1) genuine NSF (`decline_code: insufficient_funds`) 2) issuer risk scoring flagged transaction -> forced 3DS -> ACS challenge failed. The `acs_status: cookie_block` indicates the ACS iframe couldn't set cookies (same-site/sandboxing). Could be customer browser or our iframe headers.

liam_sre: I pulled gateway latency around the timestamps — we had a spike at 2025-03-11T14:02Z (p95 ~ 4.2s) which correlates with the failed challenge window. Not definitive but increases chance ACS handshake timed out.

ash_payment: Immediate mitigations:
- Suggest merchant enable alternate acquirer fallback (acq_fallback: true) for autopay.
- For autopay retries, use exponential backoff: attempt windows at +30m, +2h, +6h instead of immediate retries.
- Temporarily disable 3DS fallback for autopay (so we don't force a user-facing challenge) and surface a payment failure to merchant for manual update.

mia_support: How do I change the autopay policy for this merchant quickly?

ash_payment: You can toggle via internal admin UI or API. Quick CLI: 
```
PATCH /internal/v1/merchants/m_acme_01/settings 
{ "autopay": { "acquirer_fallback": true, "three_d_secure": "disable_fallback", "retry_schedule": [1800, 7200, 21600] } }
```
Apply, then trigger a manual retry from the support console for invoice #98765.

raj_compliance: Heads-up: before any manual retries, redact PAN/PII in the ticket and ensure merchant consent logged (they must agree to another attempt). If the issuer's fraud flag looks erroneous, we'll need to open an acquirer dispute — keep full traces.

mia_support: Will redact and ask merchant for consent now. Also asking them to confirm cardholder is using a modern browser for the 3DS flow.

nora_am: Merchant replied: they do use an iframe-based checkout on an older SSO portal. They're willing to do a manual card update if autopay retry fails.

ash_payment: Next steps: (1) toggle policy to enable acquirer fallback and disable 3DS fallback for autopay (low-risk change, rollbackable) (2) schedule retries per backoff, (3) if failures persist with `insufficient_funds` only -> advise merchant to collect new payment method / manual settlement, (4) if `fraud_suspected` continues with consistent acquirer responses -> collect full acquirer trace and open dispute.

liam_sre: I'll monitor gateway-to-acquirer latencies and check our iframe SameSite headers. If we see cookie attr mismatches, we'll patch headers today.

mia_support: Summarizing action items I will execute: 1) redact ticket traces and get merchant consent (in progress), 2) apply autopay setting patch via admin API, 3) trigger manual retry after changes, 4) report back in this thread with results. ETA ~ 90m.

ash_payment: Thanks — if you hit more `fraud_suspected` after acquirer fallback, ping me and I'll pull risk model logs.

raj_compliance: Keep copies of the consent and the sanitized traces for audit. If we end up disabling 3DS fallback long-term for this merchant, compliance sign-off required.

mia_support: Got it. Will update here when retry completes. :thumbsup:
